description: Ads for one Meta page — active by default, Meta's top-by-impressions order, sort_by and date window, same envelope as /facebook/search. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, or ALL for every country (Meta's own value). Default US. For inactive ads prefer ALL: a single-country search can list far fewer inactive ads than ALL. Other non-ISO codes are a definitive 400 INVALID_COUNTRY.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor. Pages through the current Meta HTML result batch.

end_date.description: Only ads shown (delivered) on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call on the native path; the extended fallback bills per returned ad.

sort_by.description: Meta sort mode: total_impressions or relevancy_monthly_grouped. Omit for Meta's default ranking (top ads by impressions first).

start_date.description: Only ads shown (delivered) on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Delivery-date window, not a start-date filter: an ad that started earlier but was still running in the range is included.

status.description: Ad delivery status: ACTIVE (default), INACTIVE, or ALL. Use ACTIVE for "what are they running now?".

url.description: pageId from /search-companies (preferred), libraryUrl, vanity page URL (facebook.com/nike/), or Ad Library URL with view_all_page_id. Do not pass profileId from facebook.com/{digits}/ when it differs from pageId. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.
